description: Applies transformation_rules defined in the config to output a normalized response object.
trigger_condition: Immediately after successful adapter API response received

input_parameters.description: Raw JSON response from downstream API
Config payload defining mappings and casts
ID of the executing client tenant

output.on_success: transformed_response (normalized), transformation_summary listing every rule applied
output.on_failure: raw_response passed through unchanged, transformation_failure logged

error_codes.HOOK_001: Invalid JSON path expression in transformation rules.
error_codes.HOOK_002: Type casting failed (e.g. string to integer).
error_codes.HOOK_003: Attempted to transform entirely null payload.
